description: Find units and revenue needed to cover fixed costs. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Use inputs.fixed for fixed costs, with inputs.price and inputs.variable for per-unit amounts. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

fixed.description: Fixed cost in period. Matching invoice, quote, statement, bookkeeping record or explicit budget amount for fixed cost in period. Use the stated period and exclude amounts already counted in another field. Zero means intentionally excluded/not incurred, not unknown. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

price.description: Selling price per unit. Matching invoice, quote, statement, bookkeeping record or explicit budget amount for selling price per unit. Use the stated period and exclude amounts already counted in another field. Zero means intentionally excluded/not incurred, not unknown. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

variable.description: Variable cost per unit. Period variable expense ÷ matching units for a consistent product mix; excludes fixed expenses. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.
